Measure full PNR accuracy and diagnose nonphysical click moment projection

Generate12 preregistered65536-record two-port PNR tasks and four full1152 direct-click quality jobs. Preserve every failure, the rejected oldest-factor closure, and the first compile attempt. Match full conditional second moments while retaining one click, then diagnose its negative probability by independent100-digit sums. Report scoped confidence intervals, serial performance and hardware gaps without claiming general superiority.

Validation: 9955 independent final checks; 1024 tests run, 995 successful, zero failures/errors; five new native tests. Separate99-percent families combine to at least98 percent.
